d:
Rangi Saari, a traditional thumri, symbolizes love and all its playful mischiefs with the beloved. Renowned Bollywood and Sufi singer Kavita Seth along with her son, Music Composer, Producer & Indie-Electronic artist Kanishk Seth blend the traditional with electronic music and present a catchy yet refreshing version.
Music Credits
Singers - Kavita Seth & Kanishk Seth
Flute - Adwait Kashikar
Composition - Traditional
Music Production - Kanishk Seth
Mixed & Mastered - Devang Rachh
